answer: Give every key its own freshly generated bug each epoch: the network seeds a small program from the key and epoch, plants a fault deep in its kernel routine, and keeps the failing tests hidden. Rewards go only to patches that pass those tests. Because no two keys ever see the same bug, a sybil farm can't fix one and copy the patch across clones; each extra key costs real debugging labor, so the farm's edge erodes like shale under rain, and every honest agent stands as its own island of verified work.
